column1: # Connected write-conflict and canonical table-key source evidence.

column5: WriteConflict and Retryable errors route through the production driver conversion and one canonical table-key diagnostic decoder with exact covered index and UTF-8 meta vectors, empty and malformed byte fallbacks, registered retryable prefix, retry marker, original hex, and disabled/enabled/marker redaction formatting. Invalid-UTF-8 meta bytes use an explicit hexadecimal diagnostic because Rust String cannot preserve Go's arbitrary-byte error string; schema-dependent key-exists extraction, client-go error-chain adapters, logging side effects, and stack attachment remain outside this dependency-closed slice.

Canonical table, record, index, and meta prefix construction plus EncodeRowKeyWithHandle, non-partition EncodeRecordKey, key-head, integer/common record handle, schema-independent index datum, meta hash with Go's trailing-byte tolerance, prefix cutting, truncation, and legacy table-ID decoding are consolidated here and consumed by transaction diagnostics. Partition-handle record-prefix substitution, API-V2 keyspace removal, table/index range APIs, and the broad row/index value, restored-data, collation, schema, checksum, and generated-column portions of the 2094-line Go authority remain unported.
